items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: her mother was married to Flowers, who was Native American.

ctx.x: Of course he was Indian, you know. He knew Mother Earth and Father Sky, you know. He had - Her father was an Irish man, Bud McCone was my grandmother’s father,
and her mother was married to Flowers, who was Native American. But he was black, because in the South you were either black or white. There was no gradation, you know.
